name: Your Name
summary: System administrator with 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Windows Server and Linux environments, Active Directory, network infrastructure, and virtualization. Builds and operates a personal lab (Proxmox, EVE-NG, Wazuh) — brings security awareness to every infrastructure task. Comfortable with scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and automating routine admin work.

jobs.title: System Administrator
bullets: Administered Windows Server (2016/2019) and Ubuntu/Debian servers; managed AD, GPO, DNS, DHCP for 50+ users
Set up and maintained Hyper-V and VMware virtualization clusters; handled VM provisioning and snapshot management
Configured and maintained network equipment (MikroTik, Cisco); managed firewall rules, VLANs, VPN tunnels
Implemented and monitored backup solutions; ensured system uptime and performed incident response
Wrote PowerShell and Bash scripts to automate user provisioning, log rotation, and patch deployment

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Intern
bullets: Deployed and hardened server infrastructure: Vaultwarden on Docker + Nginx Proxy Manager + automated backups
Configured Wazuh SIEM and Suricata IDS on Proxmox; wrote detection rules from live pcap analysis
Designed enterprise network topology (NGFW + WireGuard VPN + IDS + endpoint protection)
Configured a TLS gateway: certificate generation, key transfer over SCP, Windows CSP integration
Automated Wazuh agent deployment and removal across 50+ hosts using Python + paramiko over SSH

volunteering.title: IT Volunteer
bullets: Helped fellow students set up Linux workstations, VPN access, and lab virtual machines
Ran informal workshops on Active Directory basics and network troubleshooting

lab_bullets: Proxmox hypervisor running EVE-NG (Cisco/MikroTik/Juniper topologies), Wazuh SIEM, and Suricata IDS for continuous practice
Vaultwarden self-hosted deployment: Docker, Nginx Proxy Manager, automated SQLite backups (Bash + Python)
Mass SSH automation: paramiko-based scripts for fleet-wide agent deployment/removal across 50+ Ubuntu hosts

studies.title: BSc, Computer Science
bullets: Coursework: operating systems, computer networks, databases, cryptography, algorithms
Ran the student network lab: maintained 20 workstations, VLAN segmentation, and a lab DNS/DHCP server
Captain of the university CTF team; organised two intramural jeopardy-style competitions
Thesis: automated deployment and monitoring of a small-office network with Ansible and Zabbix
